Rough(Erin, True) ::: Erin is rough.

Rules:
Young($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: All young things are white.
Green(Anne, True) >>> Young(Anne, True) ::: If Anne is green then Anne is young.
Cold($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: If something is cold then it is young.
Blue($x, True) && Rough($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: All blue, rough things are red.
Blue($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All blue things are cold.

Query:
Red(Anne, False) ::: Anne is not red.
